title: Children's Diamond Stickers Handmade Crystal DIY
body_html:
Product information:
Name: 20 EVA diamond stickers
Product material: paper products + acrylic (color subject to the actual product)
Packing: Plastic Pack
Weight: about 60 grams/piece

Product description:
This is a very simple and interesting diy toy, learn through games.
Probably can be photographed by classification according to needs. It can train children's concentration and patience, enhance children's sensitivity to color, and cultivate children's creative ability and rich imagination. The cultivation of logical thinking, the cultivation of EQ intelligence. Many of them were played by my six-year-old son and ten-year-old niece.
This product must be used under the direct supervision of an adult. It contains small parts. Please do not swallow it to avoid danger. It is not suitable for children three years old and below.

Production Method:
Each picture is equipped with rhinestone stickers, and children can beautify the cards or dress up the cards freely by following the pattern and digital hints on the card surface. Just paste the diamonds one by one on the cardboard according to the number and color on the picture, and paste it step by step, and a diamond painting will be completed.

Size Information:
Size: Appearance size: about 26.5*19CM

Packing list:

Stickers*1  Stickers*5
